snippet.title: The Dark Queen of Mortholme Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: September 2025
snippet.description:
You are the final boss, the Dark Queen of Mortholme, unrivaled in power. A hero invades and is easily crushed. Yet, they keep returning. A short-form indie game about an unusual bond, perspectives, and the beauty of change.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3587610/The_Dark_Queen_of_Mortholme/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.

Love indie games? Subscribe and hit the bell!

Six One Indie is a grassroots collective focused on making gaming showcases, awards, and overall visibility more approachable for independent developers.
